new.aliases: TNPSC Group I; CCSE-I; Tamil Nadu Group 1; TNPSC Deputy Collector exam
new.forms_out: June (2026: notification 23 June, applications from 30 June)
new.test_date: September (2026 prelims 27 September, moved from 6 September); 2025 prelims was 15 June
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university. Minimum age 21; maximum 34 years for 'Others' and 39 years for SC, SC(A), ST, MBC/DC, BC, BCM and destitute widows for most posts (as on 1 July 2026; a few posts differ). Mains includes a compulsory Tamil Eligibility Test paper.
new.application_fee: One-time registration Rs. 150/-; prelims fee Rs. 100/-; mains fee Rs. 200/- (no fee for SC, SC(A), ST, PwBD, destitute widows; limited free chances for MBC/DNC, BC, BCM and ex-servicemen)
new.paper_pattern: One objective paper of 3 hours: General Studies (175 questions, 250 marks) and Aptitude & Mental Ability (25 questions, 50 marks), 200 questions and 300 marks in all. Screening only; not counted in the final merit list.
new.selection_process: Prelims (objective) → Mains (Tamil eligibility paper + 3 GS papers) → Interview → Document verification
new.remarks: Tamil knowledge is needed to clear the Mains Tamil eligibility paper. Vacancies often rise through addenda after the notification.

applicants.note: 2026 prelims (27 Sep 2026): 2,23,444 applied and 2,23,440 permitted to appear, per a news report the day before the exam (not explicitly quoting TNPSC). Appeared figure not found.

vacancies.note: Notification 05/2026 had 26 posts; Addendum 5B/2026 (13 Aug 2026) added 20, total 46 (also reported by LiveChennai). For comparison the official TNPSC press release 118/2025 lists 78 Group I vacancies for 2025.

new.notes: Age, fee and pattern from Testbook's summary of the 2026 notification; official notification PDF not opened. Negative marking and exam mode not confirmed in sources opened, left empty. Official press release 118/2025: 78 vacancies, prelims 15.06.2025, 1,843 called for mains (2025 cycle).

new.selection_process: Written exam (OMR) → Certificate verification → Counselling & post allocation
new.remarks: Single written exam with no interview; posts include VAO, Junior Assistant, Typist and Tax Collector. Vacancy numbers often rise after the notification.

new.exam_name: TPSC TCS/TPS (Tripura Civil Service and Tripura Police Service Grade-II Examination)
new.aliases: TCS Grade II; TPS Grade II; Tripura Civil Service; Tripura Police Service; TPSC TCS
new.last_date: As per notification (30 April 2022 for Advt. 05/2022)
new.test_date: As per notification (Advt. 05/2022 prelims held 2 April 2023)
new.marking: 1/4 of the question's marks deducted per wrong or multiple answer
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university; knowledge of Bengali/English/Kokborok is desirable. Age 21-40 years (as on 1 March 2022 for the last advertisement); 5 years relaxation for SC, ST, PwBD and government servants. SC/ST candidates of other states apply as general.

new.exam_name: UPPSC PCS (Combined State/Upper Subordinate Services Examination)
new.aliases: UP PCS; UPPCS; Uttar Pradesh PCS; UPPSC Combined State Upper Subordinate Services
new.test_date: Prelims 6 December 2026 (per news); 2025 prelims was 12 October 2025
new.marking: 1/3 of the question's marks deducted per wrong answer
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university; some posts need specific degrees (e.g. LLB, postgraduate maths/statistics). Age 21-40 years as on 1 July 2026; relaxations for reserved categories as per UP rules. Final-year students may apply.

new.exam_name: UKPSC PCS (Uttarakhand Combined State Civil/Upper Subordinate Services Examination)
new.aliases: Uttarakhand PCS; UKPSC Upper PCS; Upper PCS; UK PCS
new.marking: 1/4 of the question's marks deducted per wrong or multiple answer
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university (some posts need specific or postgraduate degrees). Age 21-42 years as on 1 July 2026; relaxations as per Uttarakhand rules. Reserved-category and fee concessions are for Uttarakhand categories. Mains has a compulsory General Hindi paper (35% minimum).

new.exam_name: WBCS (West Bengal Civil Service Executive etc. Examination)
new.aliases: WBCS Exe; WBPSC WBCS; West Bengal Civil Service; WBCS Executive
new.forms_out: As per notification (WBCS 2024 exam: notified 14 November 2025)
new.last_date: As per notification (December 2025 for the 2024 exam)
new.test_date: As per notification (WBCS 2024 prelims held 14 June 2026)
new.marking: +1 per question; negative marking applies (see notification for the deduction)
new.eligibility: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university. Must be able to read, write and speak Bengali (not required if the mother tongue is Nepali). Minimum age 21 (20 for Group B police); upper limit varies by group (A, B, C, D) and sources conflict, so check the notification. Relaxations for SC/ST, OBC of West Bengal and PwBD.
new.application_fee: Rs. 210/- plus service charges (no fee for SC/ST of West Bengal and PwBD 40%+)
new.paper_pattern: One objective paper: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2.5 hours; 8 subjects of 25 questions each (English, General Science, Current Events, History of India, Geography of India with West Bengal focus, Polity & Economy, Indian National Movement, General Mental Ability). Screening only.
new.selection_process: Prelims (objective) → Mains (written; Groups A & B add an optional subject) → Personality test → Document verification
new.remarks: Exam years lag behind: the 'WBCS 2024' exam was notified in late 2025 and its prelims held in June 2026. Bengali is required for most candidates.
new.notes: Applicants missing: no registered/appeared count found for WBCS 2024 (Advt. 08/2024) prelims; 3,842 provisionally qualified for Mains (result 5 Nov 2026, Notice 399-PSC/CON, per FreeJobAlert). Vacancies missing: the advertisement did not state a total and no official vacancy list for 08/2024 was found; ~800 figures on coaching sites are estimates. WBCS 2025 (Advt. 03/2025) only had an indicative advertisement (29 Nov 2025) on the official site. Age limits conflict between aggregators (e.g. 21-36 vs 21-41 for Groups A/C).

new.exam_name: UPSSSC PET (Uttar Pradesh Preliminary Eligibility Test)
new.aliases: UP PET; PET; UPSSSC Preliminary Eligibility Test
new.marking: +1 per correct answer; negative marking applies (one source says -0.25)
new.eligibility: Class 10 pass (higher qualifications can also apply). Age 18-40 years as on 1 July 2026; relaxations for reserved categories as per UP rules. The score is valid for 3 years.
new.application_fee: Rs. 185/- (General/OBC, incl. Rs. 25/- processing fee); Rs. 95/- (SC/ST); Rs. 25/- (PwBD)
new.paper_pattern: One objective paper: 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours, covering history, geography, polity, general science, arithmetic, Hindi, English, reasoning and general awareness.
new.selection_process: PET (eligibility test) → Shortlisting on PET score for post-wise UPSSSC main exams → Main exam → Document verification
new.remarks: PET is not a job by itself; it is needed to apply for most UPSSSC Group C posts, which shortlist on PET score.

applicants.note: PET 2025 (6-7 Sep 2025) per the UPSSSC result notification dated 9 Dec 2025 as reported by CareerIndia. For PET 2026 the commission chairman said 35.42 lakh registered (FindMyCollege, Sep 2026); 2026 result not yet out.

new.notes: Vacancies null: PET is an eligibility test with no posts of its own. Age, fee, pattern and validity from Physics Wallah's 2026 summary; official notification not opened. Negative marking value unclear (PW page lists -0.25 in one place but not in its pattern section).
